note: Canonical vocabulary for the Stormy corpus. Every asset record in corpus.json must use category/type values from this file. The MCP server and the UI Hall both read it, so the vocabulary can be extended in one place.

mobile-app-ui.label: Mobile app UI
mobile-app-ui.blurb: Screens, flows and mockups for phone apps. The core of the corpus.

app-store-screens.label: App Store screens
app-store-screens.blurb: Store listing panels - the framed marketing shots that sell an app.

before-after.label: Before / after
before-after.blurb: Paired evidence: the same screen done badly and done well. Highest teaching value.

website.label: Website
website.blurb: Marketing sites, landing pages and web product surfaces.

design-system.label: Design system
design-system.blurb: Tokens, components, spacing, icon sets, tool panels.

color-palette.label: Colour palette
color-palette.blurb: Named two-tone colour pairings with printed hex values.

illustration.label: Illustration
illustration.blurb: In-app and marketing illustration, backgrounds, decorative art.

dashboard.label: Dashboard
dashboard.blurb: Data-dense product surfaces: metrics, tables, charts.

motion-demo.label: Motion demo
motion-demo.blurb: Clips whose whole point is the transition, not the static screen.

promo-reel.label: Promo reel
promo-reel.blurb: Marketing video: app presented, not an interface to copy.

types.multi-screen: Several screens of one flow shown together.
types.flow-walkthrough: A sequence of screens documenting a user journey.
types.component: An isolated component or widget, not a whole screen.
types.pattern: A recurring layout idiom worth naming.
types.reference: Informational, useful as a data point rather than as a layout to copy.
types.brand-mark: A logo, mascot, icon or identity asset rather than an interface.

roles.onboarding: First-run, education, permission priming, value proposition.
roles.auth: Sign in, sign up, verification, account recovery.
roles.home: The landing tab or main surface after launch.
roles.feed: Chronological or algorithmic stream of items.
roles.detail: Single-item view: product, post, article, profile.
roles.landing-section: One section of a long marketing page.

styles.minimal: Restrained. Few elements, generous whitespace, no decoration.
styles.editorial: Type-led, magazine-like hierarchy. Strong typographic contrast.
styles.card-based: Content grouped into discrete rounded surfaces.
styles.flat: No shadows or gradients. Shape and colour do all the work.
styles.glassmorphism: Frosted translucent layers over a colourful backdrop.
styles.brutalist: Raw, high-contrast, deliberately unrefined. Often monospace.
styles.playful: Bright, rounded, characterful. Illustrations and bouncy shapes.
styles.corporate: Trust-first: blues, clean grids, restrained type.
styles.luxury: Dark or deep palettes, thin type, lots of negative space.
styles.retro: Deliberately dated cues: pixel, 70s palettes, cassette-futurism.
styles.gradient-heavy: Large saturated gradients as the main visual device.
styles.monochrome: One hue, varying only in lightness.
styles.high-contrast: Extreme value separation for accessibility or drama.
styles.dark-mode: Dark background as the primary surface.
styles.light-mode: Light background as the primary surface.
styles.rounded: Large corner radii as a signature.
styles.soft-shadow: Depth from diffuse elevation rather than borders.
styles.outlined: Borders rather than fills define surfaces.
styles.bold-typography: Very heavy weights used at large sizes.
styles.soft: Rounded shapes, pastel or sanded colour, low-contrast edges. Friendly rather than severe.

tags._comment: Free-form but normalised. Add here when a new recurring term appears.
tags.emoji: Emoji used as UI content or as a reaction control.
tags.reaction: Attached reactions (hearts, thumbs, taps) on content or messages.
tags.thread-reply: A reply shown nested or quoted inside a conversation.
tags.link-preview: A rich preview card generated from a shared URL.
tags.price: Prices, cost figures and price-change indicators.
tags.product-grid: A grid or list of multiple products.
tags.plant: Botanical, foliage or plant-shop subject matter.
tags.divider: Explicit separator rules or labelled dividers between blocks.
tags.option-list: A list of tappable single-choice options.
tags.wellness-coach: Habits, coaching, energy and daily check-in flows.
tags.sustainability: Climate, environment and sustainability subject matter.
tags.sorting: Explicit sort control or a list stated to be sorted.
tags.line-art: Illustration drawn as open outlines with no fills.
tags.testimonial: A customer quote or review presented as social proof.
tags.composer: The message-composition bar at the foot of a chat.
tags.dense-content: Deliberately high information density in one view.
tags.multi-panel: One image showing several app screens side by side.
tags.timestamp: Relative or absolute time labels on items.
tags.assistant: An AI assistant or agent as the product's subject.
tags.banner: A wide promotional strip inserted into a list or feed.
tags.balance: An account balance or headline monetary total.
tags.quick-actions: A compact row of shortcut actions.
tags.heat-map: A grid of intensity-shaded cells representing activity.
tags.legend: A key explaining what colours or symbols mean.
tags.quiz: A question-and-answer step inside a flow.
tags.recommendation: Suggested content presented as a personal pick.
tags.numeral: A very large display number used as the focal point.
tags.exploration: Several layout variants shown together for comparison.
tags.address: A postal or delivery address block.
tags.location: A place, pin or map position.
tags.tracking: Following an order, delivery or journey over time.
tags.artwork: Cover or sleeve artwork as a focal image.
tags.chapter: Chapter or segment list inside a long media item.
tags.atmospheric: Mood-led imagery with no interface on it.
tags.automotive: Vehicle, driving or in-car subject matter.
tags.course: A structured learning programme or its unit.
tags.lesson: A single teaching unit inside a course.
tags.electric-vehicle: Battery, charging or EV-specific subject matter.
tags.transaction: A money movement listed with merchant and amount.
tags.ledger: A running list of dated monetary entries.
tags.destination: A travel place presented as the subject of the screen.
tags.qr-code: A QR code used as a scanner or pairing target.
tags.books: Books, reading or a personal library.
tags.metric-tile: A small boxed figure with a label, in a row of such boxes.
tags.running-route: A recorded run or ride with a traced path.
tags.astrology: Star signs, horoscopes and birth-chart subject matter.
tags.constellation: Star patterns, celestial charts and night-sky linework.
tags.zodiac: A specific star sign and its reading.
tags.horoscope: A dated personal reading for a sign.
tags.guidance: Advice or a suggested course of action presented to the user.
tags.glyph: A small abstract symbol used as an icon or chart marker.
tags.radial: A chart or layout arranged around a centre point.
tags.nebula: Soft cloud-like colour washes used as a background.
tags.level: A numeric progression rank for the user.
tags.semantic-colour: Hue used to carry state meaning rather than decoration.
tags.states: A set of status values shown together as a component.
tags.single-colour: One saturated colour used across a whole asset.
tags.budget: Spending plans, savings targets and money allocation.
tags.report: A summarised account of measured data.
tags.cover: Cover or sleeve artwork as a focal image.
tags.segmented-control: A row of mutually exclusive view options.
tags.greeting: A personalised salutation with the user's name.
tags.highlights: A short list of notable items pulled from a larger set.
tags.comment: A user comment attached to a piece of content.
tags.featured: An editorially promoted item given hero treatment.
tags.full-bleed: An image running edge to edge with no margin.
tags.gym: Strength or gym-based training rather than running or cycling.
tags.session: One bounded period of activity, with a start and an end.
tags.membership: A paid or tiered membership programme.
tags.points: A loyalty or reward point balance.
tags.people: Human subjects or a roster of named individuals.
tags.route: A traced path between two points.
tags.scrubber: A draggable playback or progress control.
tags.shelf: A horizontally scrolling row of cards.
tags.specimen: A component shown in isolation for reference.
tags.tiles: A grid of small square shortcuts.
tags.track-list: A list of songs with artist and duration.
tags.transfer: Moving money between accounts or people.
tags.emphasis: One item deliberately made visually dominant.
tags.upgrade: An upsell toward a paid tier.
tags.timer: A countdown or stopwatch as the primary control.
tags.payout: Money paid out to a seller or creator.
tags.earning: Income accrued by a seller or creator.
tags.revenue: Top-line money earned, usually as a figure in a dashboard.
tags.creator: Creator-economy tooling and reporting.
tags.trading: Buying and selling of financial instruments.
tags.restaurant: Dining, ordering-at-table or table-booking subject matter.
tags.invite: Inviting other people into a group or session.
tags.merchant: A named business the user transacts with.
tags.expiry: An expiry date or time limit on an offer.
tags.halftone: A dot or line screen pattern used as texture.
tags.gauge: A dial-style measurement rather than a bar.
tags.icon-button: An icon-only control with no visible label.
tags.layer: A z-order layer control inside an editor.
tags.history: A chronological record of past actions.
tags.modes: Named presets the user switches between.
tags.snapshot: A single captured moment of a longer process.
tags.agents: Multiple named AI agents presented as a set.
tags.bars: A bar chart, horizontal or vertical.
tags.dashed-border: A dashed outline signalling an unfilled slot.
tags.table: A table booking, seating plan or table-based service.
tags.device: A physical device paired with, or tracked by, the app.
tags.insights: Derived observations presented as a short list of findings.
tags.live: Data updating in real time rather than on refresh.
tags.pairing: Connecting a device or account to the app.
tags.placeholder: A non-interactive stand-in for content not yet present.
tags.sparkline: A very small inline line chart.
tags.station: A named stop or station on a route.
tags.stepper: A numeric field with increment and decrement controls.
tags.trends: Change over time presented as its own view.
tags.service: A bookable service offered by a provider.
tags.order: A placed order and its fulfilment state.
tags.receipt: An itemised bill for a completed or pending order.
tags.itemised: A cost broken into its constituent lines.
tags.weekly: A seven-day period as the unit of the view.
tags.methodology: An explanation of how a figure was derived.
tags.template: One layout reused across several different contents.
tags.vitals: Measured body readings such as blood pressure or glucose.
tags.success: A positive completion state after an action.
tags.feedback: The app acknowledging what the user just did.
tags.payment: A payment method or a completed payment.
tags.saved-places: Persistently stored addresses such as home and work.
tags.watchlist: A saved list of media to watch later.
tags.perks: Membership benefits bundled with a subscription.
tags.accent: One colour used as the interface's only highlight.
tags.overview: A whole product or dataset shown at a glance.
tags.sheets: Multiple screens assembled onto one reference sheet.
tags.allocation: Splitting a pot of money across categories or targets.
tags.campaign: A time-boxed promotional or marketing push.
tags.cart: A basket of items gathered before checkout.
tags.composition: The arrangement of elements in a poster or key visual.
tags.shell: The persistent outer frame of an app around its content.
tags.staging: An area where work is prepared or held before going live.
tags.sticky: An element pinned so it stays visible while the content scrolls.
tags.summary: A condensed restatement of a longer set of details.
tags.yellow: Yellow as a screen's accent or dominant surface colour.
tags.lime: Bright yellow-green as a screen's accent colour.
tags.mint: Pale blue-green as a screen's accent colour.
tags.amber: Warm orange-yellow used for figures or highlights.
tags.green: Green as a screen's accent or success colour.
tags.badge: A small circular or square marker attached to another element.
tags.thumbnail: A small representative image inside a row or card.
tags.chip: A compact pill-shaped control or label.
tags.scrim: A translucent dark layer placed over content behind a sheet.
tags.call-to-action: The single emphasised button or link a screen is built around.
tags.consent: An explicit permission request made to the user.
tags.alert: A prominent notice about a change, limit or problem.
tags.nav-bar: The persistent bottom or top navigation bar of an app.
tags.floating-action-button: A circular button floating above the content.
tags.data-table: A many-row table of aligned values rather than a chart.
tags.week-strip: A horizontal row of day cells marking a week.
tags.body-map: A human-body diagram used to pick or show a location.
tags.percentage: A percentage figure used as the headline value.
tags.result: The computed output of a tool or calculator.
tags.photographic: Built on real photography rather than illustration or flat colour.
tags.real-estate: Property, housing or a listings marketplace.
tags.listings: A set of items offered by a seller or agent.
tags.logistics: Moving goods: dispatch, routes and delivery windows.
tags.ordering: Placing an order for goods, usually food.
tags.team: A group of people working together inside a product.
tags.roster: A named list of members with their state.
tags.dosage: A measured amount of a medicine or treatment.
tags.spending: Money going out, tracked by category.
tags.limit: A cap on spending or usage.
tags.audit: A full record intended for checking rather than browsing.
tags.itinerary: A dated travel plan across several stops.
tags.mood: An emotional state selected by the user.
tags.caption: A short explanatory line attached to an image.
tags.hand: A hand holding the device, presented as a product shot.
tags.unit: A unit of measurement the user can switch.
tags.album: A released collection of songs as cover art plus title.
tags.centred: Content deliberately centred on an otherwise empty ground.
tags.clause: A contractual or policy condition shown for review.
tags.list-row: One item in a vertical list, as distinct from a card grid.
tags.pink: Pink as a screen's accent or signature colour.
tags.blue: Blue as a screen's accent or primary-action colour.
tags.arrow: A drawn arrow used to direct the eye.
tags.checkbox: A tick-box control for completing an item.
tags.histogram: A bar distribution paired with range selection.
tags.day-view: A calendar showing one day as a column of time slots.
tags.goal: A savings or fitness target with progress toward it.
tags.savings: Putting money aside toward a target.
tags.reminder: A scheduled nudge for a future time.
tags.sharing: Giving other people access to a list or item.
tags.catalogue: A browsable wall of many separate items.
tags.laptop: A laptop shown as context in a product shot.
tags.desk: A desk surface shown as context in a product shot.
tags.mark: A small character or logo mark used as a brand device.
tags.member: One named person inside a shared group.
tags.token: A named crypto asset with its own badge and ticker.
tags.circle: A circular motif carried across a design as its signature shape.
tags.discount: A reduction applied to a price, shown as its own line.
tags.totals: A final summed block of labelled figures.
tags.time-slot: A bookable delivery or appointment window.
tags.feature-tour: A short sequence of explainer slides.
tags.play: A play control or play affordance on media.
tags.statistics: A row of headline counts describing a person or account.
tags.calculator: A tool that takes named inputs and returns a computed figure.
tags.redesign: A before/after pair showing the same screen built two ways.
tags.alignment: Content deliberately aligned to one column and gutter.
tags.structure: Containment and rhythm imposed on content, as opposed to a loose layout.
tags.hierarchy: A clear order of importance across type and colour.
tags.ad: An advertisement placed inside product content.
tags.reward: Points, cash or credit earned for an action.
tags.book: Book covers, reading or a personal library.
tags.scan: Reading a code or object with the camera.
tags.figurative: Illustration of a person or creature rather than an abstract shape.
tags.concept: Exploratory work presented as a direction rather than a shipped screen.
tags.overlay: Type or controls placed directly on an image.
tags.rating: A score or star value attached to an item.
tags.depth: Layering, shadow and tilt used to imply a third dimension.
tags.layered: Several cards or panels stacked to imply z-order.
tags.mono-typography: A monospaced face used as the display or accent type.
tags.wordmark: A brand name set as type rather than drawn as a symbol.
tags.lockup: A mark and a wordmark fixed together at one ratio.
tags.inverse: A mark or layout reversed out of a dark ground.
tags.favicon: An icon shown at the size a browser tab would render it.
tags.small-size: An asset deliberately shown very small as a legibility test.
tags.large-size: An asset deliberately shown very large as a construction test.
tags.variants: The same asset presented across sizes, grounds or colourways.
tags.construction: The geometry and guides a mark is built on.
tags.symmetry: A composition mirrored about one or more axes.
tags.monogram: A mark built from one or more initials.
tags.capsule: A thick rounded bar used as a mark's primary shape.
tags.sphere: A rendered ball or pebble applied as a character or brand object.
tags.orbit: A ring or traced path circling a central body.
tags.star: A star used as subject matter or as an accent.
tags.owl: An owl as a mascot or mark.
tags.smile: A character's smile as the friendly element of a mark.
tags.still-life: An arranged tabletop scene used as a brand photograph.
tags.cinematic: Lit like a film frame, with strong directional light and depth.
tags.laboratory: A lab or bench setting used as brand context.
tags.gold: Gold or warm amber used as a premium accent.
tags.presentation: An asset shown as a spec sheet or case-study board.
tags.character: An illustrated person or creature used as the brand's face.
tags.node: A boxed element in a diagram with connectors attached.
tags.concept-map: A radial map of related ideas around a central term.
tags.decision-tree: A branching diagram of choices and their outcomes.
tags.architecture: A system diagram showing parts and their connections.
tags.sequence: An ordered set of stages read left to right.
tags.annotated: A canvas carrying in-progress notes and labels.
tags.sketch: Drawn by hand to look like a working draft.
tags.paper: A paper-textured ground used behind a diagram.
tags.colour-ladder: The same treatment shown at successive stages.
tags.swatch: A colour or treatment sample presented as a tile.
tags.texture: A grain, spray or weave applied as surface treatment.
tags.tutorial: An explainer showing how an effect was produced.
tags.legal: Contract or policy text shown for reading or agreement.
tags.column: A single narrow measure of body text.
tags.masthead: A publication title treated as a display graphic.
tags.newsletter: An email or update sign-up capture.
tags.billing: Payment method, plan and invoice management.
tags.announcement: A one-off launch or availability notice.
tags.benefit-list: A numbered list of what a product gives you.
tags.mockup-grid: A wall of small panels presenting many screens at once.
tags.landmark: A recognisable building or monument used as subject matter.
tags.skyline: A continuous run of buildings forming a horizon.

tags.reviews: A list or count of user reviews on a product or service.

tags.earnings: Money earned, payouts and income figures.
